description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Sanctum Prelate.
As the token Sanctum Prelates enter the battlefield, choose the following numbers: 0, 1, 2, 3, and any other number.
Cast Gaddock Teeg by paying {G}{W}.
Because of Gaddock Teeg and the Sanctum Prelate tokens, noncreature spells cannot be cast.
